profile.name: Eugene Huang
profile.title: Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Engineer with 9+ years building and maintaining web applications across PHP, Ruby, and Vue.js stacks. Experienced diagnosing and resolving technical issues for distributed, cross-country teams and clients, and turning one-off fixes into reusable tools and components adopted by other engineers and end users. Comfortable owning a project end-to-end, from database design to front-end delivery, while collaborating daily with developers, PMs, and designers across multiple countries.

highlights: Built and maintained a client-facing web application drawing on a database of 1M+ influencer profiles, helping clients across multiple countries find influencers that matched their needs.
Built a Google Chrome extension so clients could access the company's web tool directly from their browser, simplifying what had been a manual, multi-step workflow.
Set up a local Prometheus and Grafana monitoring stack, instrumenting Ruby services to export metrics and building dashboards with Slack alerts to surface system issues in real time.
Designed reusable Vue.js components adopted by other engineers on the team, improving front-end consistency and development speed.

Integrated multiple third-party APIs (e.g. Google, Meta, Instagram) to ingest and normalize influencer data across varying data structures and sources, keeping the platform's dataset current and consistent.
Diagnosed and resolved recurring cross-region connectivity issues by setting up an Etcd cluster to sync data in real time between teams in China, Europe, and Taiwan.
Built the Project Booking System, integrating data across teams and countries and customizing regional settings to meet local users' needs, which reduced duplicate work for sales teams.
Collaborated daily with developers, PMs, and designers across multiple countries to build and maintain internal system services.
Containerized services with Docker and assisted with deployment via GitLab CI/CD on Kubernetes.
Introduced end-to-end testing with Python Selenium into the CI pipeline, improving the team's ability to catch issues before release.
Used Redis to cache frequently changing data such as daily exchange rates and other dynamic system values, reducing redundant database queries across services.
